metrics.barge_in_ms: frames from first voiced you-frame while me is speaking to first silent me-frame, x frame_ms; worst event in the spec
metrics.onset_ms: frames from end of user turn (last voiced you-frame + 1) to first voiced me-frame, x frame_ms; worst event in the spec
metrics.onset_p50_ms: median of every onset event across all specs in the run (aggregate)
metrics.onset_p95_ms: 95th percentile (nearest-rank) of every onset event across all specs (aggregate)
metrics.e_to_a_frames: frames from a scripted E-in shift (|delta| >= 0.2 on valence or arousal) to the first frame where E-out changes; worst event
metrics.attunement: min(responsive, non_escalating) in [0,1]. responsive = share of E-in shifts answered by E-out within affect_to_voice_max_frames; non_escalating = share of consented frames where E-out arousal <= max(E-in arousal, 0.3)
metrics.affect_out_changes: number of frames where E-out differs from the previous frame (must be 0 without SENSE+ADAPT or under a prohibited purpose)
metrics.me_onsets_while_user_speaking: me-band onsets that start on a frame where the you-band is voiced (floor grabs)
metrics.late_frames: scripted late frames (a late frame is a pause, never a glitch)
metrics.lean_in_ms: PLACEHOLDER (Q-RIKA.Q17 = YES). Rika lean-in latency from evidence frame to E-out lean-in, x frame_ms. Reported as null and assertions on it evaluate to 'pending' until A10 lands rika.rs.

forbidden_note: No engagement objective (A4 invariant 1). Attunement replaces it. The validator rejects any spec, metric or assertion whose name contains a forbidden word.
audio_note: WAV-driven specs (A13 wave 2). you_wav paths resolve against this file's directory. Format: RIFF/WAVE integer PCM (tag 1 or EXTENSIBLE/PCM), mono or stereo (downmixed (L+R)/2), 8/16/24/32-bit, 8-192 kHz with whole 80 ms frames. Per-frame RMS gate: speech >= speech_dbfs (default -35), breath >= breath_dbfs (default -55), else silence. Fixtures are synthetic (sine + seeded LCG noise), regenerated by `cargo test -p galion-presence --test wav -- --ignored regenerate_fixtures`.

specs.description: Mono 8 kHz 16-bit fixture: silence 0..5, speech 5..20 (220 Hz, -13.5 dBFS), breath-level noise 20..23, silence to 40. Same shape as P2, driven from audio.
Stereo 8 kHz 16-bit fixture: user voice on the left channel only, frames 12..20 (downmix -19.5 dBFS). Galion mid-utterance 2..30 must yield within 200 ms.
